title: Mphe maleme a sekete

lines.translation: Grant me a thousand tongues to proclaim
And make known to the whole world
To spread throughout the world, the honours of Your Name
Jesus the name that bids our sorrows and fears cease
Tis music in the sinners’ ears, it brings deliverance
He breaks the power of sin

lines.primary: Mali a hae a ka hlatsoa

lines.translation: His blood can make the defiled hearts clean
When the dead hear Jesus’ voice
Be set free through Jesus’ grace
Your sins have been laid on Jesus’ shoulders
His soul has been made an offering

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Mphe maleme a sekete,
Le ‘na ke tlerole;
Grant me a thousand tongues to proclaim
Ke utloahatse ka hohle,
And make known to the whole world
Li hlolo tsa mohau.
The triumphs of God’s Grace

VERSE 2
Moren’a ka ea mohau,
My gracious Master
Nthuse ke bolele,
Assist me to proclaim
Litlotliso tsa hao tsohle,
Fatseng lena lohle.
To spread throughout the world, the honours of Your Name

VERSE 3
Jesu, lebitso le fenyang
Masoabi le tsabo;
Jesus the name that bids our sorrows and fears cease
Ho baetsalibe bohle,
Le tlisa topollo.
‘
Tis music in the sinners’ ears, it brings deliverance

VERSE 4
O roba matla a sebe;
He breaks the power of sin
O lokolla batho;
He sets the prisoner free
Mali a hae a ka hlatsoa
Lipelo tse khopo.
His blood can make the defiled hearts clean

VERSE 5
Bafu ha ba utloa lentsoe
La Morena Jesu,
When the dead hear Jesus’ voice
Ba amohela bophelo
Bo bocha kaofela.
They receive a new life

VERSE 6
Batho bohle, lumelang, hle
Eveybody, please believe
Moren’a bophelo;
The Lord of Life
Le lopolloe ka mohau,
Oa Morena Jesu.
Be set free through Jesus’ grace

VERSE 7
Libe tsa lona li beiloe
Mahetleng a Jesu,
Your sins have been laid on Jesus’ shoulders
O ineetse sehlabelo,
His soul has been made an offering
Ka baka la batho.
For every soul of man
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Uhalalehile! Molimo moholo

lines.primary: Ha ho ea tšoanang le uena ka khalalelo.
U halalehile! Bohle ba u hlompha,
Li itihela pel’a maoto a hao,
Ba sitoa ho boha khalalelo ea hao,
Ea u bonang a ke ke a phela.
U matla ´ohle, u na le tsebo eohle.

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Uhalalehile! Molim’o moholo,
Ha ho ea tšoanang le uena ka khalalelo.
U halalehile, hape u lerato,
U lokile, hape u mohau.

VERSE 2
U halalehile! Bohle ba u hlompha,
Lirafime le likerubime tsohle
Li itihela pel’a maoto a hao,
Li ikhurumetsa lifahleho.

VERSE 3
U halalehile! Ka har’a lefifi,
U ipata mahlong a baetsalibe;
Ba sitoa ho boha khalalelo ea hao,
Ea u bonang a ke ke a phela.

VERSE 4
U halalehile! Molim’o moholo,
U matla ´ohle, u na le tsebo eohle.
U halalehile! Molim’o mohau,
U Molimo o bokoang hararo.
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Rea u boka Morena

lines.translation: We glorify You God and You alone
And we live joyfully under Your protection.
We have been saved by grace,

lines.primary: Reko la hao le le holo
lines.translation: and have caused our hearts to rejoice
As of now let Your children
Let it be an easy yoke,
Give us everything that You desire
And let Your will be done,
That Your children be the special.

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Rea u boka Morena,
Re ntse re thabela Uena
We glorify You God and You alone
Re saphela ha monate,
Ka paballo ea hao Ntate.
And we live joyfully under Your protection.

VERSE 2
Re pholositsoe ka mohau
With all your blessings
Ka lineo tsohle tsa hao,
We have been saved by grace,
Reko la hao le le holo
and have caused our hearts to rejoice
Le re thabisitseng pelo.
Your mercies are uncountable,

VERSE 3
Khana joale bana ba hao
Follow Your righteous laws,
Bae ka taba tsa molao,
As of now let Your children
E be joko e bobebe
that is carried with bravery
E sikaroang ka sebete.
Let it be an easy yoke,

VERSE 4
U re nee ho thabela
Tse u li ratang kaofela
Give us everything that You desire
Thato ea hao e phethehe
And let Your will be done,
Bana baho ba khethehe.
That Your children be the special.
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Boholo ba Bomolimo

lines.translation: He is the Lord of heavens

lines.primary: Ha o rata o ka otla,
lines.translation: If you like, you can punish
You are capable of destroying us

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Boholo ba Bomolimo
The Greatness of God
Bo ka angoa ke mang?
Who can match it?
Ke Moren’a maholimo,
He is the Lord of heavens
Moren’a tsabehang.
The awesome Lord

VERSE 2
Ha o rata o ka otla,
If you like, you can punish
’Me o ka folisa;
Or you can heal
O matla ho re timetsa
You are capable of destroying us
Le hore phelisa.
And saving us

VERSE 3
Mohlang oo o halefelang,
The day He gets angry
Litlolo tsa rona;
With our trespasses
Ke mang ea tla arabelang
Who can account,
Lipotso tsa oona?
Against His accusations?

VERSE 4
Tabeng tsohle o moholo
He is the God Almighty,
Ho ba o lumelang;
To those who believe
‘Me o kutloelo-bohloko
And He is merciful,
Ho ba o rapelang.
To those worship Him

VERSE 5
A re holiseng Morena,
Lets us exalt the Lord
Ka pelo e utloang;
With a willing heart
Re phethise ka potlako
Let us be swift,
Tse re li laoletsoeng.
In what we are commanded
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Morena, ke mona

lines.translation: Our hearts are yearning for You
Even our spirits, long for You
We desire to have communion with You

lines.primary: Lentsoe la hao ha le rutoa,

lines.translation: When we pass on, accept us in heaven

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Morena, ke mona,
Lord I am here
Re se re kopane,
We are gathered
Motlotloaneng oa hao mona,
In your house
Tlo u be le rona.
Come be with us

VERSE 2
Lipelo tsa rona,
Lia u tsetselela;
Our hearts are yearning for You
Le eona meea ea rona
Ea u lakatsa.
Even our spirits, long for You

VERSE 3
Puisano le Uena
Rea e hlorela;
We desire to have communion with You
Lentsoe la hao ha le rutoa,
As Your word is read
U ikutloahatse.
Be revealed to us

VERSE 4
Ak’u re lokise,
Rona batho ba hao,
Make us righteous, sanctify us
Ha re oroha re nkeloe,
Leholimong la hao.
When we pass on, accept us in heaven
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Rorisang lipuo tsohle
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Rorisang lipuo tsohle,
Leholise Morena.
Maholimo a mo tlotle
Ka lifela tsa 'ona.
Alleluya,
A tume le ho rõna.

VERSE 2
Matla a hae a hlolile
Khanya ea linaleli.
Ka nģa tsohle ho atile
Bongata ba bapheli.
Motlotlehi,
O apere leseli.

VERSE 3
Maru ke koloi ea hae,
Eo a lumang ka eona.
Moe ke pheho tsa hae,
Tseo a fofang ka tsona.
O ka hohle,
Le ka pelong tsa rõna.

VERSE 4
Manģosa a hae ke meea
E mo etsetsang poko.
Lialuma tsa hae li re
Kokobetsa ho eena.
Itokiseng,
Tšabang bohale ba hae.

VERSE 5
Molomo oa hae o laotse,
'Me põpo ea e-ba teng,
Le metheho ea lefatše,
Le lithaba tsa lona.
Molaoli,
O bua ka borena.

VERSE 6
Ho khora ha liphoofolo,
Lipula tsa lehoetla,
Liliba tsa mahlo'nolo,
Ho sisa ha likhomo,
Lintho tsohle,
Li thabela Molimo.

VERSE 7
Tsohle li mo lebeletse,
Li ja tsohle ho eena.
Lerato le li abetse
Menate ea Morena.
Alleluya,
Ho Molimo oa rõna.
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Ka utloa ke thaba pelong

lines.translation: Glad was my heart to hear,
Come in the Temple, it is a blessed day.”
Our feet come and stand before the door.

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ka utloa ke thaba pelong,
Glad was my heart to hear,
Metsoalle ea ka e mpitsa,
When my friends called me,
E re: “Tlo kena tempeleng,
Come in the Temple, it is a blessed day.”
Ke tsatsi le hlomphehang.”
And they said unto me,“

VERSE 2
Maoto a rona a tla
Ema ka har’a monyako.
Our feet come and stand before the door.
Ba baholo le bacha,
Ba thabele ho kena teng.

VERSE 3
Matsoele a tla phutheha
Moo bohle ba u rapelang;
Ka lipelo tse thabileng,
Ba khumame aletareng.

VERSE 4
Ka har’ a mabota ana,
Ho fumanoe matseliso;
Sione, makhotleng a hao,
Ho tlala khora ea pelo.

VERSE 5
Merapelo e sa feleng,
E etsetsoe banabeso,
Kamehla ha ba kopana,
Lehlohonolo le ba teng.
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Molimo oa poloko
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Molimo oa poloko,
Eka nka be ke filoe
Maleme a sekete,
Ho bina thoko tsa hao.

VERSE 2
Jesu lebitso la hao
Le khaola litlamo
Tsa libe tse nkimelang,
Tse ntsitisang ho bina.

VERSE 3
U tlositse ho tsaba,
U ntokolotse bobeng;
Mali a hao a hlatsoa,
Sesenyi se litsila.

VERSE 4
U buile ka utloa,
Pelo e ncha ea ntlela;
Ka kenoa ke pholiso,
E tsoileng maling a hao.

VERSE 5
Lichaba amohelang,
Molimo o lereko,
Lona bohle lumelang,
Le hloleloe meleko.
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Bokang Molimo oa khanya

lines.translation: Praise be to the God of Light
He ceases not to have mercy

lines.primary: Le ho moea e be thoko
lines.translation: And to the Spirit be extolment

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Bokang Molimo oa khanya,
Praise be to the God of Light
Molim’o re entseng
The God who created us
Ketso tsa oona li benya,
His glorious acts
Li khanya lefatsêng.
Are reflected in this world

VERSE 2
Kamehla o re tsoarela
Everyday he forgives
Libe tse sa baloeng,
Countless trespasses
Ha o phetse ho hauhela
He ceases not to have mercy
Batho ba sitiloeng.
Upon people who have sinned

VERSE 3
Ho isoe hlompho le poko
Praise and honour be
Ho Ntate le Mora
To the Father and Son
Le ho moea e be thoko
And to the Spirit be extolment
Joale le kamehla.
Now and forever.
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Pelo ke na le eona
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Pelo ke na le eona,
Moea ke na le oona,
‘Mele ke na le oona,
Botho bohle ke ba ka.

VERSE 2
Nthute Mong a marena
ntlatse Mong a marena.
Ke tsebe ho u boka,
Ka botho bohle ba ka.

VERSE 3
‘Mele, pelo le moea,
Le hohle ho ka ho ‘na;
Ho ithute kamehla,
Ho rorisa Morena.

VERSE 4
Ha nka sitoa ho boka
Uena Mong a bophelo;
Ka sitoa hom khumama,
Phelo ba ka bo thusa’ng.

VERSE 5
Oho nthuse Morena,
Ke se nyoreloe ho hong,
Le seo ke se lakatsang,
E be ho u tlotlisa.
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Lula le rona, Morena

lines.primary: Ha re na letho la rona,
Le mantsoe a hao a matle;

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Lula le rona, Morena,
Re utloe molemo oa hao,
Ha re na letho la rona,
Rona mafutsana a hao.

VERSE 2
Lula le rona, ‘Moloki,
Le mantsoe a hao a matle;
Re thuse re se fapohe,
Melaong ea hao e metle.

VERSE 3
Lula le rona, Ra-khanya,
U re bonesetse rona;
Re tsebe ho li boloka,
Litaba tsa hao kaofela.

VERSE 4
Lula le rona, Monghali,
Ka lereko le ka toka;
Re lakatsa ho u tseba,
Le tsela ea boiketlo.

VERSE 5
Lula le rona Molimo,
U re boloke ka mosa,
Likotsing, lefatseng lena,
U re pholose, Morena.
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Pula tsa lehlohonolo

lines.translation: O Jesus, my Lord, please don’t overlook me.
O, don’t bypass me my Lord,
Pour Your rain drops on me,
O Jesus, my Lord, please don’t overlook me.

lines.primary: Ha u fa ba bang hakalo,
lines.translation: When you give others so much,
Do also give me just a little bit.
O Jesus, my Lord, please don’t overlook me.
Give me the Spirit of Light,

lines.primary: U mphe leha e le hlase,
lines.translation: And give me just a spark,
O Jesus, my Lord, please don’t overlook me.
O Jesus, my Lord, please don’t overlook me.

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Pula tsa lehlohonolo,
Ha li na ka melupe,
When Showers of blessings, fall,
Hohle e le liphororo,
When everywhere it’s heavy downpour
Le `na hle u nkhopole.
Please, do remember me.

VERSE 2
O Jesu, mong a ka,
U se ntebale le `na.
O Jesus, my Lord, please don’t overlook me.

VERSE 3
Oho! se mphete, Monghali,
O, don’t bypass me my Lord,
Bona, ke omeletse;
Look how dehydrated I am;
Rothisetsa marotholi,
Pour Your rain drops on me,
Le `na u nkolobise.
And make me wet.

VERSE 4
O Jesu, mong a ka,
U se ntebale le `na.
O Jesus, my Lord, please don’t overlook me.

VERSE 5
O `Moloki ea lerato,
O, loving Saviour,
Ke khomaretse uena;
I am clinging unto you;
Ha u fa ba bang hakalo,
When you give others so much,
Mphe hanyenyane le `na.
Do also give me just a little bit.

VERSE 6
O Jesu, mong a ka,
U se ntebale le `na.
O Jesus, my Lord, please don’t overlook me.

VERSE 7
U mphe Moea oa leseli,
Give me the Spirit of Light,
Oa bophelo le matla;
Of Life and Power;
U mphe leha e le hlase,
And give me just a spark,
E bonese ka ho `na.
That it shines within me

VERSE 8
O Jesu, mong a ka,
U se ntebale le `na.
O Jesus, my Lord, please don’t overlook me.

VERSE 9
Pontšo tsa lerato la hao,
Illustrations of your love
Sokoliso ea Moea,
Spiritual battles,
Le menono ea mohau,
And enrichments of your mercy,
Le `na nšitse ka tsona.
Bestow me graciously

VERSE 10
O Jesu, mong a ka,
U se ntebale le `na.
O Jesus, my Lord, please don’t overlook me.
author: Difela tsa Setso

VERSE 1
Se mphete uen’a ratehang
Don’t disregard me, loving Lord
‘Moloki oa ka ;
My Saviour ;

Chorus:

Have mercy on me too.

VERSE 4
Chorus:

Jesus, Jesus, I pray to you

May You not disregard me

Na ke ne ke tla tsepa mang,

,

Heal me too.

VERSE 6
Chorus:
Jesu, Jesu, kea u rapela,

When you bless others
Se mphete le nna
May You not disregard me

Ha ke na se u khalisang,
I’ve nothing to please you
Ke mofutsana ;

Se mphete le nna

VERSE 10
Chorus:
Jesu, Jesu, kea u rapela,
Jesus, Jesus, I pray to you
Ha u ntse u sitsa ba bang
When you bless others
Se mphete le nna
May You not disregard me

Tsohle tsee ke li thabelang
All that I delight in
Li tsoa ho uena
Comes from You

Love me too.

title: Ha khohola se nkuka, ke lebetse ke le mong

lines.primary: Ha khohola se nkuka, ke lebetse ke le mong,
lines.translation: When the storms of life are raging, abandoned and lonely,

lines.primary: Ke le har’a meleko, har’a mello e nkoelang,
lines.translation: When tempted and put through the fire

lines.primary: Ha ke feta malibeng, tsoara matla a ‘ona;
lines.translation: Save me from the might of deep sorrows I face

lines.primary: Ha ke tsietsoa ke ‘ona, ha ke teba ho ‘ona,
lines.translation: When I’m in danger and about to sink

lines.primary: Ha sebe se nkhatella, tsepo ea ka e fela,
lines.translation: When oppressed by sin, and drift into hopelessness

lines.primary: Ha lefu le nkatella, Ke feta har’a lona,
lines.translation: When death is imminent, and have to pass through it

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ha khohola se nkuka, ke lebetse ke le mong,
When the storms of life are raging, abandoned and lonely,
Ke le har’a meleko, har’a mello e nkoelang,
When tempted and put through the fire
Oho nkhopole Ea Matla x4
Remember me, O Mighty One.

VERSE 2
Ha ke feta malibeng, tsoara matla a ‘ona;
Save me from the might of deep sorrows I face
Ha ke tsietsoa ke ‘ona, ha ke teba ho ‘ona,
When I’m in danger and about to sink
Oho nkhopole Ea Matla x4
Remember me, O Mighty One.

VERSE 3
Ha sebe se nkhatella, tsepo ea ka e fela,
When oppressed by sin, and drift into hopelessness
Ha lefu le nkatella, Ke feta har’a lona,
When death is imminent, and have to pass through it
Oho nkhopole Ea Matla x4
Remember me, O Mighty One.
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Morena,ka lentsoe lena

lines.translation: Thy word is a lamp and light on my path,
And also of your truthfulness, Master.
My Lord, in my heart, You bring comfort through Your word
It is encouragement in times of temptation.
Because of Your word, I forsake all
Indeed, I am empowered with love
Do reach us with Your word,
And by the Spirit of Life,

lines.primary: Re tle re be bang le uena.
lines.translation: So we may be one with You.

lines.primary: Re tle re be bang le uena.

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Morena,ka lentsoe lena,
Lord, through Your word,
Le ‘na ke bone mohau.
I have received grace.
Ka pitso ea hao Morena,
Kajeno ke ngoana oa hao.

VERSE 2
Uena Jesu, Moren’a ka,
You, Jesus, my Lord,
Lentsoe la hao ke leseli,
Ke lebone tseleng ea ka,
Thy word is a lamp and light on my path,
La ‘nete tsa hao Monghali.
And also of your truthfulness, Master.

VERSE 3
Moren’a ka, lentsoe lena
Pelong ho ‘na ke tseliso
Eo u mphumantsang eona;
My Lord, in my heart, You bring comfort through Your word
Ke khothatso le melekong.
It is encouragement in times of temptation.

VERSE 4
Ka lona ke tela tsohle,
Because of Your word, I forsake all
Leha li ka ‘na tsa mpota
Le ka mahlakoreng ‘ohle.
Even trials that overwhelm me
Ruri ke ruisoa lerato.
Indeed, I am empowered with love

VERSE 5
Jesu, Morena oa mosa,
Jesus, merciful Lord,
Re thole ka lentsoe lena,
Do reach us with Your word,
Le ka Moea oa Bophelo,
And by the Spirit of Life,
Re tle re be bang le uena.
So we may be one with You.

VERSE 6
Morena, ka lentsoe lena,
Le ‘na ke bone mohau,
Ka pitso ea hao Morena,
Kajeno ke ngoana oa hao.

VERSE 7
Uena Jesu, Moren’a ka,
Lentsoe la hao ke leseli;
Ke lebone tseleng ea ka,
La ‘nete tsa hao Monghali.

VERSE 8
Moren’a ka, lentsoe lena
Pelong ho ‘na ke tseliso
Eo u mphumantsang eona,
Ke khothatso le melekong.

VERSE 9
Ka lona ke tela tsohle,
Leha li ka ‘na tsa mpota
Le ka mahlakoreng ‘ohle,
Ruri ke ruisoa lerato.

VERSE 10
Jesu, Morena ea mosa,
Re thole ka lentsoe lena,
Le ka Moea oa Bophelo,
Re tle re be bang le uena.

Lefifing le letšo-letšo
Le mofuteng o khopo,
Ikhetheng, lōna ba Jesu,
Khabang ka khalalelo. .

VERSE 2
Le khanye, le eme qhooeng,
Le bonesetse tsela,
'Me e mong ea lahlehileng,
A ka bona, a phela.

VERSE 3
Se pateng seli la lōna,
Se keng la ba le lihlong,
Kamehla pakang Morena
Hohle le linyefolong.

Le khanye, le eme qhooeng,

Le khanye : o ! se beng ngoeli
E seli le maruru,
E meriti le lesoiti,
E eeng e lahle batho.

VERSE 6
Le khanye, le eme qhooeng,
Le bonesetse tsela,
'Me e mong ea lahlehileng,
A ka bona, a phela.

VERSE 7
Le khanye : o ! se beng ngoeli
E seli le maruru,
E meriti le lesoiti,
E eeng e lahle batho.

VERSE 8
Le khanye, le eme qhooeng,
Le bonesetse tsela,
'Me e mong ea lahlehileng,
A ka bona, a phela.
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Tsamaea, itsebeletse
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Tsamaea, itsebeletse,
U thabele thato ea hae;
Ke tsela e tsamailoeng,
Ke Morena, Mong a rona.

VERSE 2
Nka mehlala eo mohlanka,
Leha tsohle li lahleha;
Batho ba sa u thabele,
U thabeloa ke Molimo.

VERSE 3
U sebetse motseare,
Bosiu bo atametse;
U khaohane le botsoa,
Ha se tsela ea poloko.

VERSE 4
Ba timela pontseng ea hao,
Ba sena tsepo le lefung;
Emisa lebone la hao,
Le tla qhalanya lefu.

VERSE 5
U sebetse, se khathale,
Hlalefela ho boloka;
Phallela ‘mileng e kantle,
Baleleri ba tlisoe hae.

VERSE 6
U thabele mosebetsi,
U tla tleloa ke phomolo;
U mamele lentsoe le reng:
“Bonang o tlile Monyali.”
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Nke ke behe litholoana

lines.translation: In my heart all the time ;
Yes, they should help to free me,
From my countless sins that defeat me ;

lines.primary: Le tsohle tse tlang le tsona

lines.translation: So that my behavior and my ways can never be questioned.

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Nke ke behe litholoana
May I bear the fruit
Tsa Moea o Halalelang ;
Of the Holy Spirit ;
Botle, boikokobetso,
Goodness, humility,
Ho loka le oona mosa,
Righteousness
and kindness,
Tsohle ts’e leng tsa tumelo
All that are of faith,
Tsa lerato le tsa khotso.
Of love and peace

VERSE 2
Tsohle tsena a li hole,
All these should grow,
Pelong ea ka mehla eohle ;
In my heart all the time ;
E, li nthuse ke phonyohe,
Yes, they should help to free me,
Libeng tse ngata tse nhlolang ;
From my countless sins that defeat me ;
Boikhohomoso le mona,
Pride and jealousy,
Le tsohle tse tlang le tsona
And everything associated with them

VERSE 3
Moren’a ka ke lakatsa
My Lord I desire
Ho hlahisa litholoana ;
To bring forth fruit ;
Tsa pako le tsa tumelo,
Of testimony and faith
Tsa ntho tsohle tse ratehang,
And everything that is loveable,
Ho se ke ha belaeloa,
Mekhoa le litsela tsa ka.
So that my behavior and my ways can never be questioned.
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Ke batla Moea oa matla

lines.translation: I want the Spirit of Power
The love that stretches out to all
When will I hear the voice

lines.primary: Tlo, hle, Moea oa ho loka,

lines.translation: Revive the gifts of the heart
That I should not block the way

lines.primary: Ba sa le teng ba ntseng ba e-tla.
lines.translation: Of those that are still coming

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ke batla Moea oa matla,
I want the Spirit of Power
Oa lerato pelong ea ka;
And love in my heart
Matla a ho fenya sebe,
The power to break sin
Lerato le eang ho bohle,
The love that stretches out to all
Poloko e hlolang lefu,
Salvation that defeats death
Leha ho thibiloe bobe.
Even to inhibit evil

VERSE 2
Ke tla utloa neneng lentsoe
When will I hear the voice
Le hlahang ha ho lumetsoe;
That comes when we believe
Tsoarelo, khotso le thabo,
spoken by God
Tse reriloeng ke Molimo;
Forgiveness, peace and joy
Tlo, hle, Moea oa ho loka,
Come, please, Spirit of righteousness
Hoba Jesu o ho Uena.
For Jesus is in You

VERSE 3
E re ho ‘na ke boetse,
Tell me I’ve been reaccepted
Ka bocha, ke tsoetsoe hape,
Renewed, and born again
Nkolobetse le ka mollo,
And baptise me with fire
Tsosa lineo tsa pelo,
Revive the gifts of the heart
Ke se eme har’a tsela,
That I should not block the way
Ba sa le teng ba ntseng ba e-tla.
Of those that are still coming
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Ha ke boha sefapano

lines.primary: When I survey the wondrous cross

lines.translation: When I survey the wondrous cross
On which the Prince of Glory died

lines.primary: Le ke ke la nthusa letho.
Ha e seng sefapano sa hae;
lines.translation: If it is not His cross
All the vain things that charm me most

lines.primary: Ke li tella Moren’ a ka.
lines.translation: I sacrifice them for my Lord
See His head, see His hands
Sorrow and love, are miraculously mingled together
In the one crowned with thorns
Even if I can take all the wealth of the world
It will be an insignificant gift
Demands my soul, my life, my all

lyrics:
VERSE 1
When I survey the wondrous cross
Ha ke boha sefapano,
When I survey the wondrous cross
Moo Moren’ a’k’a shoetseng teng;
On which the Prince of Glory died
Leruo la fatse lena,
The worldly wealth
Le ke ke la nthusa letho.
Will not save my soul

VERSE 2
A ho se rorisoe letho,
Nothing else should be praised
Ha e seng sefapano sa hae;
If it is not His cross
Lintho tsohle tse sa thuseng,
All the vain things that charm me most
Ke li tella Moren’ a ka.
I sacrifice them for my Lord

VERSE 3
Bonang hlohong, le matsohong,
See His head, see His hands
Masoabi, lerato, ke tseo;
Likopane ka mohlolo,
Sorrow and love, are miraculously mingled together
Ho ea roesitsoeng meutloa.
In the one crowned with thorns

VERSE 4
Leha nka rua lefatshe,
Even if I can take all the wealth of the world
Eo hase mpho e lekaneng;
It will be an insignificant gift
Rato leo le lekakalo,
That much love
Lengosa bophelo baka.
Demands my soul, my life, my all
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Sefapanong ke boha

lines.translation: With it, I say: Cleanse me
So that I can be whole and virtuous

lines.primary: Be se ke ke sa tlosoa,

lines.translation: If it is not You alone
Even if I could bring gold
They will not set my soul free,
I ‘ll put my trust in You,
So that I do not perish.
I am about to set out
When I arrive nearer to You
I have found refuge in You.

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Sefapanong ke boha
On the cross I see
Uena, ‘Moloki oa ka ;
You my Saviour ;
Mali a tsoang maqebeng,
Blood flowing from the wounds
,
Le metsi lehlakoreng,
And water from the side,
Ka ‘ona ke re : Ntlhatsoe
With it, I say: Cleanse me
Ke be motle, ke loke.
So that I can be whole and virtuous

VERSE 2
Nka sebetsa joang le joang,
I can try everything,
Ha ho letho le nthusang ;
Nothing will save me ;
Kapa e leng likhapa,
Even tears,
Mahloko, mahlomola ;
Anguish, suffering ;
Be se ke ke sa tlosoa,
Sin cannot be washed away,
Ha e se k’uena feela
If it is not You alone

VERSE 3
Leha nka tlisa gauda
Even if I could bring gold
Tsa lefatse kaofela,
Of all this world,
Ha li na ho talingoa,
They are worth nothing,
Ha li na ho ntopolla,
They will not set my soul free,
Ke tla ke tsepa uena,
I ‘ll put my trust in You,
Ke se ke ka timela.
So that I do not perish.

VERSE 4
Ke se ke tla tsamaea
I am about to set out
Eto la ho qetella ;
On a final journey ;
Pel’a hao ha ke fihla,
When I arrive nearer to You
U se ke ua nteleka,
Don’t disregard me,
Uena lefika, la ka,
You: my rock,
Ke tsabetse ho uena.
I have found refuge in You.
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Bonang sefapanong

lines.translation: Brings us back into the right path
He died because of the love,
So we can be freed from sin
He felt death in His spirit
I shall not be afraid of a path
He was hung on the tree,

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Bonang sefapanong
Look at the cross,
‘Moloki oa batho,
The people’s Saviour
Ho re lopolla tahlehong
Brings us back into the right path
A ineela lefu.
He yielded to death
.

VERSE 2
A shoa ke lerato
He died because of the love,

He has loved us with;
A re jarela thohako,
He carried our inequalities,

So we can be freed from sin
.

VERSE 3
A tsoha boimeng
He rose despite the weight,
Ba libe tsa rona;
Of our countless sins ;
Lefu a le utloa moeeng
He felt death in His spirit
Le tsiu ea lona.
With

VERSE 4
Likhororo tsa hae
His

I shall not be afraid of a path

VERSE 5
Mora oa Molimo
God’s Son

He .

A fehoa sefateng,

VERSE 8
Empa ho felile,
But it is accomplished
Molao o phethiloe;
The prophecy has been fulfilled;
Jesu o re pholositse,
Jesus has saved us
Tsohle li lokile
All is well
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Ralla le teng le letala

lines.translation: There is a green hill far away
Where the dear Lord was crucified
Who died to save us all

lines.primary: Re ke ke ra tseba kamoo,

lines.translation: What pains He had to bear
There was no other good enough
To pay the price of sin
He only could unlock the door
Of heaven and let us in
O dearly, dearly has He loved
And we must love Him too

lines.primary: A re tsepeng mali a hae,
lines.translation: And trust in His redeeming blood
And try His works to do

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ralla le teng le letala,
There is a green hill far away
Le kantle ho motse;
Outside the city wall
Moo Moren’a thakhisitsoeng,
Where the dear Lord was crucified
Hore re bolokoe.
Who died to save us all

VERSE 2
Re ke ke ra tseba kamoo,
We may not know
A hlokofalitsoeng;
What pains He had to bear
Re mpa re lumela hore,
But we believe that
O re shoetse bohle.
He died for us all

VERSE 3
Jesu o na le hona,
There was no other good enough
Ho lopolla batho;
To pay the price of sin
A ka re bulela khoro,
He only could unlock the door
Re kene bophelong.
Of heaven and let us in

VERSE 4
O re ratile hakalo,
O dearly, dearly has He loved

And we must love Him too
A re tsepeng mali a hae,

And try His works to do

title: Thabang, Jesu ke Morena
lyrics:
VERSE 1
Thabang, Jesu ke Morena;
Libupuoa, mo bineleng;
Le roriseng, le tumise
Molimo o re bopileng.
Phah’ misang pelo le mantsoe,
Thabang, tlerolang le phete.

VERSE 2
Jesu ‘Moloki oa busa,
Mong a lerato la nete:
Ha a re hlakotse libe,
O boetse leholimong.
Phah’misang pelo le mantsoe,
Thabang, tlerolang le phete.

VERSE 3
O lutse moo ho phahameng,
Ho fihla lira li fenngoa,
Ho lumela puso ea hae,
Li beoa tlas’a maoto.
Phah’misang pelo le mantsoe,
Thabang, tlerolang le phete.

VERSE 4
Thabang ka tšepo e tiileng,
Le emele Moahloli
Ea tlang ho ‘re amohela
Malulong a likisitsoeng.
Phah’misang pelo le mantsoe,
Thabang, tlerolang le phete.
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: U jarile libe, Jesu

lines.translation: You bore our sins, Lord Jesus
You paid the price, Lord Jesus
You were a man of sorrows

lyrics:
VERSE 1
U jarile libe, Jesu,
You bore our sins, Lord Jesus
E se libe tsa hao;
Yet You were without sin
Ua lefa melato Jesu,
You paid the price, Lord Jesus
Empa e se ea hao.
Yet You were without debt

VERSE 2
U bile har’a tlokotsi,
You were a man of sorrows
U se na molato;
You were without sin
Mali a hao a tsoloha,
Your blood was shed
‘Me u halalela.
Though You were Holy

VERSE 3
Litsito tsa rona tsohle,
All our transgressions
Tsa balloa ho Uena;
Were charged against You
Litlolo tsa rona tsohle,
All our inequities
Tsa balloa ho Uena.
Were charged against You

VERSE 4
Re tsoareloa, re phelisoa
Ka maqeba a hao,
Be tsa rona li hlatsoua
Ka mali a hao.
author: Your wounds; we are healed, forgiven

title: Bonang! Suna o fihlile

lines.primary: Ea ka le tselisang o teng,
E s’ e le eena Jesu!
Le libe tse ntso, tse ngata,

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Bonang! Suna o fihlile,
Jesu, ngaka ea batho,
O lerato, o sebete,
Bonang! Ke eena Jesu!

VERSE 2
O! bitso le ratehang,
Ke le letle hakakang,
Ha le binoa ke batho
Lebitso la Jesu!

VERSE 3
Utloang, lona ba soabileng,
Le khathetseng lipelo;
Ea ka le tselisang o teng,
E s’ e le eena Jesu!

VERSE 4
O! bitso le ratehang,
Ke le letle hakakang,
Ha le binoa ke batho
Lebitso la Jesu!

VERSE 5
Le libe tse ntso, tse ngata,
Tse le bakelang lefu;
O lihlakotse kaofela,
O! lumelang ho Jesu!

VERSE 6
O! bitso le ratehang,
Ke le letle hakakang,
Ha le binoa ke batho
Lebitso la Jesu!

VERSE 7
O! lehlohonolo joang!,
Le hopotsoe kajeno;
O fihlile ea le ratang,
Bonang, ke eena Jesu!

VERSE 8
O! bitso le ratehang,
Ke le letle hakakang,
Ha le binoa ke batho
Lebitso la Jesu!

VERSE 9
Le mo phapheng ka lithoko,
Mo buleleng lipelo,
Mo amoheleng ka thabo,
Eena Morena Jesu!

VERSE 10
O! bitso le ratehang,
Ke le letle hakakang,
Ha le binoa ke batho
Lebitso la Jesu!

VERSE 11
Bitso la hae le nkhapile,
Le ntlhomolisa pelo,
Joale le ka mehla eohle,
Ke tla bina la Jesu!

VERSE 12
O! bitso le ratehang,
Ke le letle hakakang,
Ha le binoa ke batho
Lebitso la Jesu!
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Re fumane mpho e kholo

lines.translation: We have all received a great gift
A divine gift from the Lord
It is a rare gift to all who have received it

lines.primary: Mpho eo ho bona ke matla,

lines.translation: It is strength to those that receive it
It is life to those that accept it

lines.primary: Mpho eo e joalo ke Jesu,

lines.translation: He is the greatest gift to all believers

lines.primary: Ka ho re fa Mora oa hae.
lines.translation: For the gift of his only begotten Son

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Re fumane mpho e kholo,
E abetsoe rona bohle;
We have all received a great gift
Re e fuoe ke Jehova,
Mpho e ntle ea leholimo.
A divine gift from the Lord

VERSE 2
Ke mpho ea bohlokoa ruri,
Ho bohle ba e fumaneng;
It is a rare gift to all who have received it
Ba e rata ka sebele,
Ho feta tsohle tsa bona.
More beloved than anything else

VERSE 3
Mpho eo ho bona ke matla,
Matla a tsoang leholimong;
It is strength to those that receive it
’Me e bile ke bophelo,
Bophelo ba leholimo.
It is life to those that accept it

VERSE 4
Mpho eo e joalo ke Jesu,
Ea abetsoeng fatse lohle;
That gift is Jesus
Ke Neo e babatsehang,
Ho ba lumetseng kaofela.
He is the greatest gift to all believers

VERSE 5
A re leboheng Molimo,
Let us thank the Lord
Ka Mpho ena ea bohlokoa;
For this great gift
Re mo isetse teboho,
Let us show our gratitude
Ka ho re fa Mora oa hae.
For the gift of his only begotten Son
author: Difela tsa Setso

lines.translation: If you ask: “In whom do I put my trust?”

lines.primary: Le re ke bone’ng ho eena?
lines.translation: You ask what have I found in Him?
The joy I have found in the Lord

lines.primary: A mpitsa a re: Tlo ho na,
lines.translation: He called me and said: “Come to me
And now I am filled every day
I have begun to take things easy

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ha le mpotsa tsepo ea ka,
If you ask: “In whom do I put my trust?”
Ke tla re ke Jesu;
I will say: “In Jesus alone”
Ke lapetse ho mo aka,
I long to hug Him
Ha hae ke ha eso.
His home is my home

VERSE 2
Le re ke bone’ng ho eena?
You ask what have I found in Him?
Ke bone phomolo,
I have found rest
Thabo e leng ho Morena
The joy I have found in the Lord
Ha e na phetoho.
Will never change

VERSE 3
Ka na ka nyoreloa botle,
I longed for goodness
Ka tsoatsoa ke batla;
I set out in search
Ka tsieloa ke ntho tsohle
I lost everything
Ka felloa ke matla.
was disheartened

VERSE 4
Athe Jesu o’n’a mpona
All along, Jesus saw me
Ha ke lela joalo;
As I wept
A mpitsa a re: Tlo ho na,
He called me and said: “Come to me
U fole matsoalo.
And find comfort”

VERSE 5
Joale, ke khotse ka mehla,
And now I am filled every day
Mohau oa Molimo
With God’s grace
Ke qalile ho iketla,
I have begun to take things easy
Tsepong ea holimo.
My trust is in heaven
.
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Ka hlahlathela feelleng halelele

lines.primary: Ke se na Molimo, ke se na tsepo
Ke tsietsoe, ke shoele ke sekoboto

lines.translation: Now I have found the real well
A well of cool and sweet water

lines.primary: Ka ‘na ka cheka, ka hlora hakakang
Ke batla metsi, empa ho se letho
Jo! Ke lehlabathe feela le monyelang

lines.translation: Now I have found the real well
A well of cool and sweet water

lines.primary: Makhatleng a ho shoa, ka utloa lentsoe
lines.translation: In the course of dying, I heard a voice

lines.primary: Le re: “Uena ea nyoriloeng, tlo metsing”
lines.translation: Saying: “You who is thirsty, come, here is water.”

lines.primary: Ha ke talima ka bona moroeroe
lines.translation: When I looked, I saw drops of water,

lines.primary: Ke Jesu! A mpitsa a eme selibeng
lines.translation: It’s Jesus! Calling me standing by the well
Now I have found the real well
A well of cool and sweet water

lines.primary: Ahe! Kea u boka, Jesu oa ka,
lines.translation: Oh Yes! I praise you, my Jesus, my Lord,
I am revitalised, I am hopeful/upbeat
Today I have peace, joy, in abundance
Now I have found the real well
A well of cool and sweet water

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ka hlahlathela feelleng halelele,
Endlessly trudging in the wilderness,
Ke se na Molimo, ke se na tsepo
Without God, without hope
Ho lefifi, nyora le nkhamile
In darkness, thirst killing me,
Ke tsietsoe, ke shoele ke sekoboto
Desolate, dying of dehydration.

VERSE 2
Chorus:
Joale ke bone seliba sa ‘nete,
Now I have found the real well
Seliba se mapholi, se monate.
A well of cool and sweet water

VERSE 3
Har’a likaka tsa libataolo
In the scorching wasteland,
Ka ‘na ka cheka, ka hlora hakakang
I dug, in great anguish,
Ke batla metsi, empa ho se letho
Searching for water, finding nothing
Jo! Ke lehlabathe feela le monyelang
It’s just sinking sand.

VERSE 4
Chorus:
Joale ke bone seliba sa ‘nete,
Now I have found the real well
Seliba se mapholi, se monate.
A well of cool and sweet water

VERSE 5
Makhatleng a ho shoa, ka utloa lentsoe
In the course of dying, I heard a voice
Le re: “Uena ea nyoriloeng, tlo metsing”
Saying: “You who is thirsty, come, here is water.”
Ha ke talima ka bona moroeroe
When I looked, I saw drops of water,
Ke Jesu! A mpitsa a eme selibeng
It’s Jesus! Calling me standing by the well

VERSE 6
Chorus:
Joale ke bone seliba sa ‘nete,
Now I have found the real well
Seliba se mapholi, se monate.
A well of cool and sweet water

VERSE 7
Ahe! Kea u boka, Jesu oa ka,
Oh Yes! I praise you, my Jesus, my Lord,
Ke le malibeng a mahlohonolo
At the well of blessings,
Ke hlapohile, ke tsoha molota
I am revitalised, I am hopeful/upbeat
Kajeno ke ruile khotso, nyakallo
Today I have peace, joy, in abundance

VERSE 8
Chorus:
Joale ke bone seliba sa ‘nete,
Now I have found the real well
Seliba se mapholi, se monate.
A well of cool and sweet water
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Ha le lakatsa ho tseba

lines.translation: Listen to what I have to say
When I show you the way
I love him, because He first loved me,
He gave me life in abundance
I love him, because He first loved me,
He gave me life in abundance
There I heard the Good News
I love him, because He first loved me,
He gave me life in abundance
Yes, today I have been saved
I am the child of God
I have faith, I have joy
I love him, because He first loved me,
He gave me life in abundance
My life will not be taken away
I love him, because He first loved me,
He gave me life in abundance
To run all the way and enter into
I love him, because He first loved me,
He gave me life in abundance

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ha le lakatsa ho tseba
If you want to know
Kamoo ke pholositsoeng
How I‘ve been saved
Mamelang, ha ke le joetsa,
Listen to what I have to say
Ke le supisa tsela
When I show you the way

VERSE 2
Jesu ke ‘Moloki oa ka,
Jesus is my Saviour
O nkhethetse bolulo,
He found refuge for me,
Kea mo rata, hob’a nthata,
I love him, because He first loved me,
O ‘neile bophelo.
He gave me life in abundance

VERSE 3
Ke ne ke shoele melatong,
I was dying in anguish
Ke ne ke hloka tshepo,
I was hopeless
Ke ne ke mathela lefung,
I was hearding towards destruction
Ke sa tshabe Modimo.
Not fearing God

VERSE 4
Jesu ke ‘Moloki oa ka,
Jesus is my Saviour
O nkhethetse bolulo,
He found refuge for me,
Kea mo rata, hob’a nthata,
I love him, because He first loved me,
O ‘neile bophelo.
He gave me life in abundance

VERSE 5
Teng, ka utloa Evangeli,
There I heard the Good News
E re, Jesu o nchoetse ;
That says: “Jesus died for me”
Ea e-ba sona sehlare
That became the remedy
Se thusang moea oa me.
That healed my soul

VERSE 6
Jesu ke ‘Moloki oa ka,
Jesus is my Saviour
O nkhethetse bolulo,
He found refuge for me,
Kea mo rata, hob’a nthata,
I love him, because He first loved me,
O ‘neile bophelo.
He gave me life in abundance

VERSE 7
E, kajeno ke folile,
Yes, today I have been saved
Ke ngoana oa Modimo,
I am the child of God
Ke lumetse, ke thabile ;
I have faith, I have joy
Ha ke na pelaelo.
I have no worries

VERSE 8
Jesu ke ‘Moloki oa ka,
Jesus is my Saviour
O nkhethetse bolulo,
He found refuge for me,
Kea mo rata, hob’a nthata,
I love him, because He first loved me,
O ‘neile bophelo.
He gave me life in abundance

VERSE 9
Leha ke le matshoenyehong,
Even when I am distressed
Ke loana ntoa e kholo,
Fighting an uphill battle
Nke ke ka sutha bophelong,
My life will not be taken away
Ke bolokoa ke Jesu.
Jesus saves me

VERSE 10
Jesu ke ‘Moloki oa ka,
Jesus is my Saviour
O nkhethetse bolulo,
He found refuge for me,
Kea mo rata, hob’a nthata,
I love him, because He first loved me,
O ‘neile bophelo.
He gave me life in abundance

VERSE 11
Monghali, kea rapela,
Lord, I am praying
U nthuse ka tiisetso,
Grant me the perseverance
Ke n’o tseba ho finyella
To run all the way and enter into
Motseng oa linyakallo.
The city of joy

VERSE 12
Jesu ke ‘Moloki oa ka,
Jesus is my Saviour
O nkhethetse bolulo,
He found refuge for me,
Kea mo rata, hob’a nthata,
I love him, because He first loved me,
O ‘neile bophelo.
He gave me life in abundance
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Lona ba ratang ho phela

lines.translation: Those that love to be in Jesus’ flock
And a small door, that is enter by force?????

lines.primary: Ha ho moo hloho ea Jesu,

lines.translation: However, Jesus doesn’t have a resting place there.
Those that pledge to follow him,

lines.primary: Ba se ke ba tshaba molao,

lines.translation: They should not be afraid of a rules that discourages us.
Let them carry their own crosses
So that they can die for the pledge they have taken

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Lona ba ratang ho phela,
Mohlapeng oa Jesu,
Those that love to be in Jesus’ flock
Hopolang tsietsi tsa tsela,
that leads to us home.
E isang ha eso.
Remember hardships along the way,

VERSE 2
Ke ‘mila o mosesane,
It’s a narrow path,
O hakang maoatla,
That traps foolish men,
Le khoro e patisane,
E kenoa ka matla.
And a small door, that is enter by force?????

VERSE 3
Nonyana li na li matlo,
Birds have homes,
Li lula monateng;
They live in harmony;
Ha ho moo hloho ea Jesu,
E ka sameloang teng.
However, Jesus doesn’t have a resting place there.

VERSE 4
Ba reng, ba mosala morao,
Those that pledge to follow him,
Ba itele pele;
Let them take charge:
Ba se ke ba tshaba molao,
O thapisang ‘mele.
They should not be afraid of a rules that discourages us.

VERSE 5
Ba inkele sefapano,
Let them carry their own crosses
Mahetleng a bona;
On their shoulders;
Ba tle ba shoele likano,
Tse ba leng ho tsona.
So that they can die for the pledge they have taken
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Seli la ka, mponesetse tsela

lines.primary: Seli la ka, mponesetse tsela, ke tsamaee.
lines.translation: My light, show me the way so I can travel

lines.primary: Ho lefifi, hape ho sebaka, ntsamaise!,
lines.translation: it is dark and the journey is long ,accompany me

lines.primary: Ha u le teng, ha ke tsabe tsebo ea ntho tsohle, Uena u ntekane
lines.translation: When You are around, I fear nothing, You are my everything

lines.primary: Khale ke ne ke sa u lakatse, ka ithata;
lines.translation: For a long time now, I did not long for You, I was full of myself

lines.primary: Ke ne ke re ke ‘na ea bohlale, ka itsepa,
lines.translation: I told my self: “I am the clever one”, I relied on myself

lines.primary: Empa joale ke ntse ke itsaba, se hopole boikhantso ba ka!
lines.translation: But now I am terrified of what I’ve become, please do not remember my pride

lines.primary: Reko la hao le se ke la mpheta, la mphuralla
lines.translation: May Your Grace not pass me by, and leave me behind

lines.primary: Litsietsing, le thateng ba tsela, ke e’o fihla,
lines.translation: Through dangers & difficult journey, until I arrive

lines.primary: Ke e’o kena seling le sa tloheng, ho Jesu eo ke mo ratileng.
lines.translation: And enter into the eternal light, and see Jesus, the One whom I love

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Seli la ka, mponesetse tsela, ke tsamaee.
My light, show me the way so I can travel
Ho lefifi, hape ho sebaka, ntsamaise!,
it is dark and the journey is long ,accompany me
Ha u le teng, ha ke tsabe tsebo ea ntho tsohle, Uena u ntekane
When You are around, I fear nothing, You are my everything

VERSE 2
Khale ke ne ke sa u lakatse, ka ithata;
For a long time now, I did not long for You, I was full of myself
Ke ne ke re ke ‘na ea bohlale, ka itsepa,
I told my self: “I am the clever one”, I relied on myself
Empa joale ke ntse ke itsaba, se hopole boikhantso ba ka!
But now I am terrified of what I’ve become, please do not remember my pride

VERSE 3
Reko la hao le se ke la mpheta, la mphuralla
May Your Grace not pass me by, and leave me behind
Litsietsing, le thateng ba tsela, ke e’o fihla,
Through dangers & difficult journey, until I arrive
Ke e’o kena seling le sa tloheng, ho Jesu eo ke mo ratileng.
And enter into the eternal light, and see Jesus, the One whom I love
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Tsietsing tsa letsoalo

lines.translation: May it go all the way
But if your harshness should blaze
To penetrate the forces that hide the sun

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Tsietsing tsa letsoalo,
When I’m troubled from within
Ke bitsa ho uena;
I cry out to You
U mamele thapelo,
To listen to my prayer
U nkutloe, Morena.
To hear me, O Lord

VERSE 2
Lentsoe la ka le fihle
My voice should reach
Tulong ea mohau,
The home of grace
A le ke le finyelle
May it go all the way
Halalelong sa hao.
To Your Mighty Throne

VERSE 3
Hoja u ka re balla
If You could count
Melato ea rona,
Our transgressions
Re ke ke ra phonyoha,
Pel’a hao, Morena.
We wouldn’t go unpunished

VERSE 4
Empa bohale ba hao,
Leha bo ka tota,
But if your harshness should blaze
Bo tingoa ke mohau,
It is extinguished by grace
Ha re sokoloha.
If we repent

VERSE 5
Ke tsepile Morena
I trust the Lord
Har’a litlokotsi,
In the midst of trouble
Ke talima ho eena
I look up to Him
Le har’a likotsi.
When I’m in danger

VERSE 6
Ke lebella leseli
I anticipate the light
Botsong ba tsietsi,
In the darkness of danger
Ho feta balebeli
Ba rakang letsatsi.
To penetrate the forces that hide the sun

VERSE 7
A re tsepeng Morena,
Let us trust the Lord
O tla re tselisa;
He will comfort us
Mohau o tsoa ho eena,
O tla re phelisa.
His grace will heal us

VERSE 8
Libeng tsa rona tsohle,
Oa re namolela,
He overcomes our sinful nature
Le matsoenyehong ‘ohle
And in all our troubles
O tla re lokolla.
He will set us free
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Haufi le Morena Nearer my God

lines.translation: Even if the crucifix—can bring me,
I draw nearer to You my God, as my time on earth comes to an end
Death is creeping in, I’m heading to my eternal home, to be with You my God
That pilgrim– only if it was me!
A stone was his pillow – he slept;
Stretch Your hand out to me, to journey through this bumpy road and reach my destination
Christ, the Way, the Truth, You are my Light, I trust only You, lead me
The day I ascend - in clouds,
I’ll lose my way without You, I’ll get hurt if You are not with me
Through this dark forest and deep waters, journey with me, my Saviour

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Haufi le Morena,-Haufinyana!
Near to the Lord, Nearer!
Leha sefapano-- se ka ntlisa,
Even if the crucifix—can bring me,
Ke ntse ke pheella
I still persist
Ho ba haufinyana
To be nearer
Le Morena
To the Lord

VERSE 2
Ndisondela kuWe, Thixo wami.
Kuphel' ixesha lam Emhlabeni;
I draw nearer to You my God, as my time on earth comes to an end
Kusondel' ukufa, Ndiz' ephakadeni,
Ndibe phambi kwaKho, Thixo wami.
Death is creeping in, I’m heading to my eternal home, to be with You my God

VERSE 3
Mosepeli eloa- Hola ke ‘na!
That pilgrim– only if it was me!
Ea samileng lejoe – A robala;
A stone was his pillow – he slept;
Bosiu a lora
At night he dreamt
A le a haufinyana
Being nearer
Le Morena
To the Lord

VERSE 4
Ndolulel' isandla, Ndithantase,
Kubugaxa-gaxa Bale ndlela.
Stretch Your hand out to me, to journey through this bumpy road and reach my destination
Kristu Ndlela, Nene, Lukhanyiso Iwami,
Se ndithembe Wena; Ndikhokele.
Christ, the Way, the Truth, You are my Light, I trust only You, lead me

VERSE 5
Mohla ke phahamang-Har’a maru,
The day I ascend - in clouds,
Ke sieang lefatse- La mahloko
Leaving this world of hardships
Ke tla ‘ne ke bine,
I will still sing
Ke be ke finyelle
Until I make it
Ho Morena.
To my Lord
.

VERSE 6
Ndiya kulahleka, Ndingenawe;
Ndiya kwenzakala, X'ungekhoyo;
I’ll lose my way without You, I’ll get hurt if You are not with me
Kuyo le ntsunguzi, Nakumlamb' omnyama,
Ma ndikhatshwe nguWe, Msindisi wam.
Through this dark forest and deep waters, journey with me, my Saviour
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Khotso, khotso

lines.translation: Don’t be frightened, it’s all in the hands

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Khotso, khotso!
Peace, Perfect Peace!
Balibe, ba khopo
The sinful, the cruel
Ba boetse ho Molimo
Have returned to God
Ka Jesu.
Through Jesus.

VERSE 2
Khotso, khotso!
Peace, Perfect Peace!
N’goso tsa letsoalo
Conscience inquisitions
La motho li phekotsoe
Of one, have been allayed
Ke Jesu.

VERSE 3
Khotso, khotso!
Peace, Perfect Peace!
Ha u ferekane
When you are distressed
Ke meleko, mothusi
Ke Jesu.
Is Jesus.

VERSE 4
Khotso, khotso!
Peace, Perfect Peace!
Baratuoa ba ile :
Loved ones, have passed away :
Motselisi oa ‘nete
The true comforter
Ke Jesu
Is Jesus

VERSE 5
Khotso, khotso!
Peace, Perfect Peace!
Tse tlang li lerothong :
The future is unknown :
Se tsabe, li matsohong
Don’t be frightened, it’s all in the hands
A Jesu.
Of Jesus.

VERSE 6
Khotso, khotso!
Peace, Perfect Peace!
Khohlong e lefifi,
In the darkest gorge,
Oa hao motsamaisi,
Your guide
Ke Jesu
Is Jesus

VERSE 7
Khotso, khotso!
Peace, Perfect Peace!
Mane mose oane,
Across, over there,
Khotso ha e senyehe
Peace cannot be destroyed
Ea Jesu.
Of Jesus.
author: Jesus.

title: Ke se ke utloile

lines.translation: You say: you will save me.
So I can be blameless too.
So I can be blameless too.
Everyday help me to conquer sin,
So I can be blameless too.
So I can be blameless too.
So I can be blameless too.

lyrics:
VERSE 1
S214
Ke se ke utloile,
I ‘ve heard you,
Jesu, ha u mpitsa ;
Jesus, when you call me ;
U mpona ke lahlehile,
Seeing me astray,
U re, ua mpholosa.
You say: you will save me.

VERSE 2
E, ke lumetse,
Yes, I do believe,
Nthole, Morena ;
Lord, Make me your own ;
Ntlhatsoe, ntlhakolisise,
Cleanse me, wholly cleanse me,
Ke be motle le ‘na.
So I can be blameless too.

VERSE 3
Ke tla ka litsila,
Despicable as I’m, I come,
Ke moetsalibe ;
I am a sinner ;
Ke tla ke le feela-feela ;
I come as I am ;
Oho nkhauhele!
Oh have mercy on me!

VERSE 4
E, ke lumetse,
Yes, I do believe,
Nthole, Morena ;
Lord, Make me your own ;
Ntlhatsoe, ntlhakolisise,
Cleanse me, wholly cleanse me,
Ke be motle le ‘na.
So I can be blameless too.

VERSE 5
Nkapese ka matla
Give me strength
Uena ka sebele ;
You my Lord ;
Ntlholele sebe ka mehla,
Everyday help me to conquer sin,
U nketse mohale,
Make me a victor,

VERSE 6
E, ke lumetse,
Yes, I do believe,
Nthole, Morena ;
Lord, Make me your own ;
Ntlhatsoe, ntlhakolisise,
Cleanse me, wholly cleanse me,
Ke be motle le ‘na.
So I can be blameless too.

VERSE 7
Uena ea mpitsitseng,
You that had called me,
Nthuise tumelo,
Bless me with faith,
Lerato le phethehileng,
Complete love,
Le khotso le thabo.
And peace and joy.

VERSE 8
E, ke lumetse,
Yes, I do believe,
Nthole, Morena ;
Lord, Make me your own ;
Ntlhatsoe, ntlhakolisise,
Cleanse me, wholly cleanse me,
Ke be motle le ‘na.
So I can be blameless too.

VERSE 9
U ntlhoekise pelo
Cleanse my heart
U mpuse le kutlo,
Make me receptive,
Tsohle tse ho ‘na tsa botho
All that I am
Li khanye ka hloeko.
Should reflect your purity.

VERSE 10
E, ke lumetse,
Yes, I do believe,
Nthole, Morena ;
Lord, Make me your own ;
Ntlhatsoe, ntlhakolisise,
Cleanse me, wholly cleanse me,
Ke be motle le ‘na.
So I can be blameless too.
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Ukhetheloe tsatsi lena

lines.translation: This is the day the Lord has made
It is Your Holy day, Lord
That I may receive with my family
In the Way of the Lord.

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ukhetheloe tsatsi lena,
This is the day the Lord has made
E leng la phomolo;
The day of rest
Ke tsatsi la hao, Morena,
It is Your Holy day, Lord
La lehlohonolo.
The day of good fortune

VERSE 2
Oho! nthuse ho mamela
O! Help me to listen
Lentsoe la bophelo,
To the Word of Life
U nthute le ho rapela
And teach me to pray
Ka tlung ea thapelo.
In the house of prayer

VERSE 3
U mpale, Morena Jesu,
Count me, Lord Jesus
Le ba u khahlisang;
In the company of saints
Ke neoe le banab’eso
That I may receive with my family
Lijo tse phelisang.
The life-giving food

VERSE 4
Taba tsa hao li hatisoe
May Your Word be understood
Lipelong tsa rōna;
In our hearts
Rato la hao le holisoe,
Your love grow
Le tuke ho tsona.
And burn in our hearts

VERSE 5
Molimo, re bana ba hao,
Lord, we are Your children
Re rutoe ke uena
Teach us
Tabeng tsohle tsa mohau,
All Your precepts of grace
Tseleng ea Morena.
In the Way of the Lord.
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Ke tsatsi la Sabbatha

lines.primary: Ke tla ba teng tulong tsa ka,

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ke tsatsi la Sabbatha,
Tsatsi le halalelang;
Le ‘na joale ke tsoanela,
Ho boka Molim ’a ka.

VERSE 2
Ke tsatsi la Sabbatha,
Tsatsi la tsoho bafung,
Moren ’a ka, le mochoeli,
O n’a tsohe ka lona.

VERSE 3
Ke tsatsi la Sabbatha,
Ke tsatsi la kopano;
Ke tla ba teng tulong tsa ka,
Ke tlale thabo le ’na.

VERSE 4
Ke tsatsi la Sabbatha,
Ke tsatsi la nyakallo,
Ka moe’a ka le leleme,
Ke tla nyolla lipoko.

VERSE 5
Ke tsatsi la Sabbatha,
Le mane leholimong;
Kea utloa, E, ka moea,
Tumiso ea moreneng.

VERSE 6
Ahe! Mong a Sabbatha!
Leha ke le lefatseng;
Kea tsepa, ke tla beba,
Ke e’o kena tumisong.
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Lala ho na, shoalane e oele

lines.translation: Abide with me, fast falls the eventide,
The shadows of the evening fall;

lines.primary: Ba neng ba nthusa ba tsamaile,
Uena, Morena, tlo, lala ho’ na.
Tšiu tsa ka li feta kapele;
lines.translation: Swiftly, my earthly days fade away ;

lines.primary: Thabo le khanya ea fatše lena,
Uena ea sa feteng, lala ho’ na.
lines.translation: O Thou, the everlasting, abide with me.

lines.primary: Ha ke batle chalimo ea mahlo,
lines.translation: I don’t wish to be a laughing stock,
I yearn to be your loved one,

lines.primary: Ke tloaelane le rato la hao,
lines.translation: I am familiar with your love,

lines.primary: Se fapohele, tlo, lala ho’ na.
lines.translation: Please do not go elsewhere, come, abide with me.
Do not come in rage ,oh Lord,

lines.primary: Tlo ka mosa, tlo ka matseliso;
Tlosa libe tsee ke llang ka tsona;
lines.translation: Take away all sins that I present unto thee;

lines.primary: Thuso ea ba sitoang, lala ho’ na.
lines.translation: Help to the helpless, abide with me.

lines.primary: Ke u lakatsa ka nako tsohle,
lines.translation: I need thee at all times,

lines.primary: Matla a hao a fenya Satane;
Ha ho motho ea joaleka Uena,
Thabong le bohlokong, lala ho’ na.
lines.translation: In joy and pain, abide with me.

lines.primary: Ha u le teng, ke tleloa ke matla,
lines.translation: I am empowered when you are near,

lines.primary: Le mahlomola, ha a sa baba;
lines.translation: Even sorrows, are no longer bitter;

lines.primary: Ha ke tšohe lefu le lebitla;
lines.translation: I don’t fear death, even the grave,

lines.primary: Ke li hlōtse, ha u lala ho’ na.
lines.translation: I have overcome them, when You abide with me.
On my deathbed, cheer me on
Shine through the darkness, and show me the way;

lines.primary: Botšo bo se, seli le nchabele,
Leholimong, u ntse u na le’ na.
lines.translation: Heaven’s morning breaks, and earth’s vain shadows flee O Thou are still with me.

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Lala ho’na, shoalane e oele,
Abide with me, fast falls the eventide,
Meriti ea bosiu ke ena;
The shadows of the evening fall;
Ba neng ba nthusa ba tsamaile,
When other helpers fled,
Uena, Morena, tlo, lala ho’ na.
Thou ,Lord, abide with me.

VERSE 2
Tšiu tsa ka li feta kapele;
Swiftly, my earthly days fade away ;
Thabo le khanya ea fatše lena,
Earth’s joys grow dim,
Tsohle lia senyeha, li timele,
They all perish and vanish,
Uena ea sa feteng, lala ho’ na.
O Thou, the everlasting, abide with me.

VERSE 3
Ha ke batle chalimo ea mahlo,
I don’t wish to be a laughing stock,
Ke lakatsa ho ba moratoana;
I yearn to be your loved one,
Ke tloaelane le rato la hao,
I am familiar with your love,
Se fapohele, tlo, lala ho’ na.
Please do not go elsewhere, come, abide with me.

VERSE 4
Se tle ka botšabeho, Morena,
Do not come in rage ,oh Lord,
Tlo ka mosa, tlo ka matseliso;
Come in compassion and comfort;
Tlosa libe tsee ke llang ka tsona;
Take away all sins that I present unto thee;
Thuso ea ba sitoang, lala ho’ na.
Help to the helpless, abide with me.

VERSE 5
Ke u lakatsa ka nako tsohle,
I need thee at all times,
Matla a hao a fenya Satane;
Your power defeats Satan;
Ha ho motho ea joaleka Uena,
There is none like you,
Thabong le bohlokong, lala ho’ na.
In joy and pain, abide with me.

VERSE 6
Ha u le teng, ke tleloa ke matla,
I am empowered when you are near,
Le mahlomola, ha a sa baba;
Even sorrows, are no longer bitter;
Ha ke tšohe lefu le lebitla;
I don’t fear death, even the grave,
Ke li hlōtse, ha u lala ho’ na.
I have overcome them, when You abide with me.

VERSE 7
Mohla ke orohang, u nkhothatse,
On my deathbed, cheer me on
Khanya lefifing, u mpontše tsela;
Shine through the darkness, and show me the way;
Botšo bo se, seli le nchabele,
Leholimong, u ntse u na le’ na.
Heaven’s morning breaks, and earth’s vain shadows flee O Thou are still with me.
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Jesu, ha u ile

lines.translation: Jesus, when You left a commandment
You said we must remember You
That is sweet, that is amazing
That was shed on the cross
You have been merciful to us

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Jesu, ha u ile,
Ua siea taelo,
Jesus, when You left a commandment
U itse, re u hopole
You said we must remember You
Ha re ja selallo.
When we receive communion

VERSE 2
Re ka lebala joang
How can we forget
Rato le leholo,
The greatest love of all
Le tsotisang, le makatsang,
That is sweet, that is amazing
La Morena Jesu?
Of the Lord Jesus?

VERSE 3
Re ka lebala joang
How can we forget
Bitso le monate
The sweetest name
La 'Moloki ea ratehang,
Of the beloved Saviour
Ea hlÕtseng Satane?
That defeated Satan?

VERSE 4
Re ka lebala joang
How can we forget
Mali a Konyana,
The blood of the Lamb
A tšolotsoeng sefapanong,
That was shed on the cross
A tšolletsoeng rÕna?.
Shed for us?

VERSE 5
Rea u hopola,
We remember You
Rea u lakatsa,
We long for You
Mohauheli oa rÕna!
You have been merciful to us
Rea u lebella.
We expect You.
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Mona Morena, haufi le Uena

lines.translation: Here, O my Lord, I see Thee face to face

lines.primary: Ke ama tse sa bonoeng ka mahlo;
Ke ntse ke itsetleha ka Uena.
Ke tla ja bohobe ba Molimo,
lines.translation: I will eat the bread from God
And feel I have laid aside all my earthly load
And enjoy the calm of sin forgiven

lines.primary: Ke nako ea pina le mokete
lines.translation: It is time for song and party

lines.primary: Ha e le moo ke tlile monateng,
lines.translation: As I am here, I’ve come to have a good time

lines.primary: Nako, se fete ka pele, hle.
lines.translation: Time, please do not tick away in a haste
Even as the party draws to the end

lines.primary: Ho tla sala Uena Mong a ka
lines.translation: And Lord You live forever more
The Sun, the Shield and Protection to me

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Mona Morena, haufi le Uena,
Here, O my Lord, I see Thee face to face
Ke ama tse sa bonoeng ka mahlo;
Empa ke itsoarella ka mohau,
Ke ntse ke itsetleha ka Uena.

VERSE 2
Ke tla ja bohobe ba Molimo,
I will eat the bread from God
Ke noe veine ea leholimo;
And drink the Royal wine
Ke imolloe meuba ea nama
And feel I have laid aside all my earthly load
Ke thabele tsoarelo ea libe.
And enjoy the calm of sin forgiven

VERSE 3
Ke nako ea pina le mokete
It is time for song and party
Ke aletsoe lijo tse khorisang;
Ha e le moo ke tlile monateng,
As I am here, I’ve come to have a good time
Nako, se fete ka pele, hle.
Time, please do not tick away in a haste

VERSE 4
Leha mokete o fela joalo,
Even as the party draws to the end
Ho sala lerato le safeteng;
But love remains
Ho tla sala Uena Mong a ka
And Lord You live forever more
Morena, Thebe le Tsireletso.
The Sun, the Shield and Protection to me
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Lona ba nkileng lebitso

lines.translation: All who call on the name of Jesus

lines.primary: Tlong le je selallo sa hae,

lines.translation: Come share in His Sacrament, and remember Him
Witness your faith in the One that was nailed to the cross
Because He instructed you while He was still on earth
It is a thanksgiving celebration, genuine thanksgiving

lines.primary: Re phetse ka lefu la hae,

lines.translation: We live because of His death, we have been purchased by blood
As we remind ourselves, we will be faithful
As we await the day we shall see Him face to face

lines.primary: Re ba shoeleng lefung la hae,

lines.translation: We died through His death, and were raised with Him
And the cross of death, has turned to be a symbol of Life

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Lõna ba nkileng lebitso
La Morena Jesu,
All who call on the name of Jesus
Tlong le je selallo sa hae,
'Me le mo hopole.
Come share in His Sacrament, and remember Him

VERSE 2
Pakang tumelo ea lõna
Ho ea thakhisitsoeng,
Witness your faith in the One that was nailed to the cross
Hobane o re laetse
A sa le lefatšeng.
Because He instructed you while He was still on earth

VERSE 3
Ke mokete oa teboho,
Teboho ea 'nete;
It is a thanksgiving celebration, genuine thanksgiving
Re phetse ka lefu la hae,
Ra rekoa ka mali.
We live because of His death, we have been purchased by blood

VERSE 4
Ha re ikhopotsa joalo,
Re tla nka tumelo;
As we remind ourselves, we will be faithful
Re ntse re supa kopano
Ea rõna le eena.
As we await the day we shall see Him face to face

VERSE 5
Re ba shoeleng lefung la hae,
Ra tsoha le eena;
We died through His death, and were raised with Him
'Me sefapano sa lefu
Se supa bophelo.
And the cross of death, has turned to be a symbol of Life
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Ea re bilelitseng

lines.translation: The One that has called us,
When we enter into this service
He became a sacrifice for our sins;
There is no such in this world
That has loved us so much

lines.primary: Re ka bang le ho tsamaea

lines.translation: On a journey towards life everlasting.
Help us by the power of the Spirit ;

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ea re bilelitseng
The One that has called us,
Tsebong ea Molimo,
To know and worship God
O itse re mo hopole
Said we must remember Him
Tsebeletsong ena.
When we enter into this service
.

VERSE 2
E, re mo hopole,
Yes, remember Him,
Boinehelo ba hae;
He became a sacrifice for our sins;
Rato le joalo le hokae?
Where is such love?,
Ha le eo lefatseng.
There is no such in this world
.

VERSE 3
E, re mo hopole,
Yes, remember Him,
Ho ba sefapano;
Because the cross ;
Le lebitla li sitiloe
contain Him
Ho mo nyahamisa.
And the grave could not

VERSE 4
E, re mo hopole,
Yes, remember Him,
Mora oa Molimo,
God’s only Son,
Ea re ratileng hakalo,
That has loved us so much
Re e-s’o mo rate.
Before we loved Him.

VERSE 5
E, re mo hopole,
Yes, remember Him,
Mahlomola a hae;
His sorrow, His pain;
A tsoanetse ho re tsosa
Is supposed to remind us
Nakong ea tebalo.
In times of forgetfulness.

VERSE 6
E, re mo hopole,
Yes, remember Him,
Ke ka matla a hae;
Because of His power/might ;
Re ka bang le ho tsamaea
We can begin to embark ;
Tseleng ea bophelo.
On a journey towards life everlasting.

VERSE 7
Jesu ea lerato,
Loving Jesus,
Rea u hopola;
We remember You;
Re sitse ka matl’a moea
Help us by the power of the Spirit ;
Re se u lebale.
Never to forget You.

VERSE 8
Ha re u lebala,
If we forget You
Konyan’a Molimo;
Dear Lamb of God;
Re nka tsel’a leholimo
We are walking towards heaven
Re se na ’Moloki.
All alone, without You, Saviour
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Jehova o itse khale

lines.translation: Jehovah knew a long time ago

lines.primary: Ke tla ba Molimo oa hao,

lines.translation: That was made to our forefathers

lines.primary: O nka le bana ba rona,

lines.translation: He even makes our children heirs with Christ

lines.primary: U ke ke ua re timetsa,
lines.translation: You will not remove our names

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Jehova o itse khale
Jehovah knew a long time ago
A bua le Abrahama;
And He spoke to Abraham
Ke tla ba Molimo oa hao,
I will be your God
Le oa litloholo tsa hao.
And God to your descendents

VERSE 2
Mantsoe ana a lerato,
These words of love
A tiisitsoe le kajeno;
Have been confirmed even today
Lengeloi la Morena
The angel of the Lord
Le boetse le pakile.
Also testified

VERSE 3
Jesu o tiisa lipallo,
Jesus strengthens the covenant
Tse entsoeng ho ba baholo;
That was made to our forefathers
O nka le bana ba rona,
O ba beha majalefa.
He even makes our children heirs with Christ

VERSE 4
Liketso tsa hao, Molimo,
Your mighty acts, Lord
Lia tsepeha, lia rateha;
Are trustworthy, are loveable
U ke ke ua re timetsa,
You will not remove our names
Bukeng ea hao ea bophelo.
From the Book of Life.
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Jesu, Molisa molemo

lines.primary: Re ka mo tsela ka metsi,

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Jesu, Molis’a molemo,
Jesus
Re tlile le ngoana
An
Ho mo tsoaela Molimo,
A abeloe oona.
An

VERSE 2
Mahlo a hao, Mor’a motho,
A shalime ngoana,
Mo amohele kajeno,
A khotse ho uena.

VERSE 3
Libe li mo khomaretse,
U mo hlatsoe tsona;
Re ka mo tsela ka metsi,
Mo tsele ka Moea.

VERSE 4
Lesea lena le hole,
Matleng le bohlaleng;
Ha le falla, le fallele,
Leholimong, botleng.
F.
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Jehova, Morena rona

lines.primary: Re ntse re phela ka uena;
lines.translation: We are still alive because of you,
Through all the years, you have been our refuge

lines.primary: E sa le lu le Molimo,
Ha u re ho bona: Khutlang!

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Jehova, Moren’a rona,
Jehovah, Our Lord,
Re ntse re phela ka uena;
We are still alive because of you,
Ka mengoaha le mengoaha,
U setšabelo sa rona.
Through all the years, you have been our refuge

VERSE 2
Lithaba li e-s’o tsoaloe,
Before the mountains were born,
Lefatše le e-s’o bopjoe,
Before the world was created,
E sa le lu le Molimo,
U sa baloe le lilemo.
You have been God,

VERSE 3
Batho bohle ke lerole,
Ho uena ka lithole,
Ha u re ho bona: Khutlang!
Eba batho ba fela hang.

VERSE 4
Ba joaleka matlakala,
A kukoang ke likhohola,
Ba feta joaleka toro
E ikelang le bosiu.

VERSE 5
Bohale ba hao bo tukang
Ke bona bo re felisang;
Libe tsa rona, Morèna,
Li bitsa kotlo ea rona.

VERSE 6
U li bèa pepeneneng,
U li hlahisa leseling,
Li bonoe tsohle ke uèna,
Le tse patiloeng ke rona.

VERSE 7
Tšiu tsa rona li ile,
Le lilemo li felile;
Lemo tsee re li baletsoeng,
Li mashome a supileng.

VERSE 8
Oho! re rute, Morèna,
Ho bala tšiu tsa rona,
Tse khutšoanyane, tse felang,
Ebe moo re hlalefisoang.
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Oho mphe mahlo ke talime

lines.translation: Show me a sneak preview of heaven
So I can see the saints, rejoicing in the Lord
While they were on earth, they wept
Trials & temptations from the devil engulfed them from all angles

lines.primary: Ke bona ba se ba e hlotse,

lines.translation: I see now they have overcome, I asked: “How?”

lines.primary: Ba re: “Ka eena ea re shoetseng”

lines.translation: “It is through Him that died for us”, they answered
They realised that He had come that they may have life in abundance
The followed in His footsteps and are now resting in heaven
Praise & honour be to the Leader, because of His exemplary life
Let there be no shortage of those who will follow Him

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Oho mphe mahlo ke talime,
Holimo leholimong,
Show me a sneak preview of heaven
Ke bone teng ba halalelang,
Ba thabile moreneng.
So I can see the saints, rejoicing in the Lord

VERSE 2
Eitse ha ba sa lefatseng,
Ba le har’a meokho,
While they were on earth, they wept
Ba hateletsoe ke meleko,
Moleki a sa phetse.
Trials & temptations from the devil engulfed them from all angles

VERSE 3
Ke bona ba se ba e hlotse,
Ka re: “Le hotse ka mang?”;
I see now they have overcome, I asked: “How?”
Ba re: “Ka eena ea re shoetseng”
Ea shoetseng batho bohle.
“It is through Him that died for us”, they answered

VERSE 4
Ba latetse mehato ea hae,
E lebisang bophelong;
They realised that He had come that they may have life in abundance
Ba tsamaea mohlaleng oa hae,
Ba phomola holimo.
The followed in His footsteps and are now resting in heaven

VERSE 5
Ha bokoe Moetelli-pele,
Ka mohlala oo oa hae;
Praise & honour be to the Leader, because of His exemplary life
Ho se hlokahale matsoele,
A ba ka mo latelang.
Let there be no shortage of those who will follow Him
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Na ke bomang mose lelibohong

lines.primary: Bohang seema, ha ba hlaha ka khoro,
Pina tsa bona tse tsoisoang ke nyakallo,
Ke ba tsoileng tsileng tsa manyala,
Ho boleng ha lebitla la sebe;
Bohang seema, ha ba hlaha ka khoro,
Pina tsa bona tse tsoisoang ke nyakallo,
Ke ba tsoang mokhathaleng oa lintoa,
Bohang seema, ha ba hlaha ka khoro,
Pina tsa bona tse tsoisoang ke nyakallo,
Ke moo ba emeng ka lipalema,
Bohang seema, ha ba hlaha ka khoro,
Pina tsa bona tse tsoisoang ke nyakallo,
Bohang seema, ha ba hlaha ka khoro,
Pina tsa bona tse tsoisoang ke nyakallo,
E, ke tla ba teng ho ba kenang ka khoro,
Ha ke bina teng le bona ka nyakallo

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Na ke bomang mose lelibohong,
Ba hlohlorang role la lebitla?
Ba leseli, ba khanya,
Ba meqhaka lihlohong.

VERSE 2
Chorus:
Bohang seema, ha ba hlaha ka khoro,
Jerusalem e mocha,
Pina tsa bona tse tsoisoang ke nyakallo,
"Ke mali a Konyana."

VERSE 3
Ke ba tsoileng tsileng tsa manyala,
Ho boleng ha lebitla la sebe;
Joale, ha ba hloekile,
"Ke mali a Konyana."

VERSE 4
Chorus:
Bohang seema, ha ba hlaha ka khoro,
Jerusalem e mocha,
Pina tsa bona tse tsoisoang ke nyakallo,
"Ke mali a Konyana."

VERSE 5
Ke ba tsoang mokhathaleng oa lintoa,
Bolibeng la lillo le hloreho;
Joale, ha ba hloekile,
"Ke mali a Konyana."

VERSE 6
Chorus:
Bohang seema, ha ba hlaha ka khoro,
Jerusalem e mocha,
Pina tsa bona tse tsoisoang ke nyakallo,
"Ke mali a Konyana."

VERSE 7
Ke moo ba emeng ka lipalema,
Ba apereng bosoeu, leseli;
'Me ha be hloka koli,
"Ke mali a Konyana."

VERSE 8
Chorus:
Bohang seema, ha ba hlaha ka khoro,
Jerusalem e mocha,
Pina tsa bona tse tsoisoang ke nyakallo,
"Ke mali a Konyana."

VERSE 9
Ke sehou sa mefuta-futa,
Ba tsoa lipheletsong tsa lefatse,
Bohle ba lopolotsoe
"Ke mali a Konyana."

VERSE 10
Chorus:
Bohang seema, ha ba hlaha ka khoro,
Jerusalem e mocha,
Pina tsa bona tse tsoisoang ke nyakallo,
"Ke mali a Konyana."

VERSE 11
O, Monghali, u ntumelle le 'na,
Ke phakise, kehabe, ke fihle;
Ntlhatsoisise ke hloeke,
Ke se ke ka roneha.

VERSE 12
Chorus:
E, ke tla ba teng ho ba kenang ka khoro,
Jerusalem e mocha!
Ha ke bina teng le bona ka nyakallo
"Ke mali a Konyana."
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Motse oo re o hlolohetsoeng

lines.primary: Re se re o bona pejana;
Leha mararan' a sa le teng,
O se o hlahile, oa khanya.
Re se re tla kopana bohle.
Bonang, ha ho sa le sebaka,
Re habeng, e s'e le phōmōlo.
Re se re hlōloa ke nyakallo;
Re se re tla kopana bohle.

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Motse oo re o hlōlōhetsoeng,
Re se re o bona pejana;
Leha mararan' a sa le teng,
O se o hlahile, oa khanya.

VERSE 2
Monateng, kapele,
Re se re tla kopana bohle.

VERSE 3
Ntate o re lebeletse teng,
Re lōkiselitsoe litulo;
Ana re tla finyella neneng
Monyakeng ola oa lerato?

VERSE 4
Se soabeng! re tsōheng mōlōta
Leha r'e-shoa ke sekoboto!
Bonang, ha ho sa le sebaka,
Re habeng, e s'e le phōmōlo.

VERSE 5
Ha re atamela haufi,
Re se re hlōloa ke nyakallo;
Rea u opela mahofi,
Motse o motle oa Molimo.

VERSE 6
Monateng, kapele,
Re se re tla kopana bohle.
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Jerusalema e mocha

lines.translation: New Jerusalem, my beloved eternal home
The residence more beautiful than Eden
How can pain and death dishearten me?
As I remember the eternal Canaan, the Home of God
It is where the glorious company of apostles

lines.primary: Ba teng le bao re neng re na

lines.translation: There are those that we have been with in this battle
That have come to live out
What we believe and hope for in this life
New Jerusalem, my beloved eternal home

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Jerusalema e mocha,
New Jerusalem, my beloved eternal home
Motse oa bakhethoa;
Home of the chosen ones
Ke hlolohetsoe ka matla,
I am yearning
Teng ho ea phomola
To go there to rest

VERSE 2
Hore mahl’a ka a bone
So my eyes can see
Menyako e metle;
Those beautiful gates
Le ‘mila ea gauda,
And the streets of gold
Motseng oa poloko
Of the home of salvation

VERSE 3
Motse o fetang Edene,
The residence more beautiful than Eden
O senang le sebe,
Where no sin is known
Meaho ea teng e metle,
And the beautiful buildings
Ke ea baphomoli.
Designed for weary

VERSE 4
Mahlaba a tla ntsietsa joang
Mahlaba a lefu
How can pain and death dishearten me?
Ha ke hopola Kanana,
Motseng oa Molimo.
As I remember the eternal Canaan, the Home of God

VERSE 5
Ke moo makhotl’a bakhethoa
It is where the glorious company of apostles
A lutseng le Jesu;
Surround the Saviour
‘Me Konyana e ba isa,
And the Lamb leads them
Libeng tsa bophelo.
To the Well of Life

VERSE 6
Ba teng le bao re neng re na
Le bona ntoeng ena;
There are those that we have been with in this battle
Bona ba se ba fihletse,
That have come to live out
Tse re li lumelang.
What we believe and hope for in this life

VERSE 7
Jerusalema e mocha,
New Jerusalem, my beloved eternal home
Motse oa bakhethoa;
Home of the chosen ones
Ke e hlolohetsoe le ‘na,
I am also yearning
Thabo ea holimo.
For the joy of heaven
author: Difela tsa Setso

title: Ke na le Molisa

lines.translation: He leads me to green pastures,
He leads me to the righteous path

lines.primary: Ha nka ke ka tsoha tsela
lines.translation: I shall not be afraid of a path
He will help me to go across
He will take care of me

lyrics:
VERSE 1
Ke na le Molisa,
I have a shepherd,
Ke tla be ke hloka’ng?
What shall I need?
Ke ea ipetsang Jehova,
He calls himself Jehovah
Molimo o phelang.
The living God.

VERSE 2
O nkisa botaleng,
He leads me to green pastures,
Dijong tseng mphelisang ;
Life – giving food ;
O nkalosa linokaneng,
He leads me to streams,
Metsing a nkholisang.
With satiating water.

VERSE 3
Ha ke lahlehile,
When I am astray,
O nkhutlisetsa hae ;
He takes me home ;
O nkisa tseleng ea ‘nete
He leads me to the righteous path
Ka lerato la hae.
With His love

VERSE 4
Leha ke tla feta
Even when I go pass
Khohlong e lefifi,
The darkest gorge,
Ha nka ke ka tsoha tsela
I shall not be afraid of a path
E cheiloeng lifi.
Full of dangers.

VERSE 5
Ke tsepa Molisa
I trust a shepherd
Ea lisang ka lesoai ;
Who herds with a whip;
Ke eena ea tla ntselisa
He will help me to go across
Ka mohau oa hae.
With his grace.

VERSE 6
Lira li ka ntlhoea,
Enemies can hate me,
Ke sa ja monono ;
I am still living well ;
Mohope oa khaphatseha ;
My cup is overflowing ;
Ke lutse ka thabo.
I am full of joy.

VERSE 7
U sa tla mpaballa
He will take care of me
Ka bophelong bona ;
In this lifetime ;
‘Me ke tla hlola kamehla
I will always live
Ka tlung ea Morena
In my Lord’s house
author: Difela tsa Setso
